name: Muffin (TrollStore)
subtitle: Wii U emulation on iOS - TrollStore build.
description: The source for Muffin - a genuine port of the Cemu Wii U emulator to iOS, built from source in the open. Work in progress, and honest about it: see STATUS.md in the repository for exactly what works and what does not. This source serves the ad-hoc signed build for TrollStore and jailbroken devices, with the JIT entitlements embedded so the recompiler can actually get executable memory. On SideStore or AltStore use the standard source instead - those re-sign at install and would strip these entitlements.

apps.name: Muffin
apps.subtitle: Wii U emulator - TrollStore build
apps.localizedDescription:
Muffin is the Cemu Wii U emulator, ported to iOS - iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 and later. The real C++ engine - PowerPC interpreter, ARM64 recompiler, the full Cafe OS HLE stack and Cemu's native Metal renderer - running under a SwiftUI shell.

This is in-progress software. A picture reaches the screen for real titles, but it is not yet a correct one, and no title has been confirmed playable end to end. The project documents its own state honestly rather than claiming more than it delivers - read STATUS.md before installing.

This source serves the ad-hoc signed build for TrollStore and jailbroken devices, with the JIT entitlements embedded so the recompiler can actually get executable memory. On SideStore or AltStore use the standard source instead - those re-sign at install and would strip these entitlements.

Bring your own games. No copyrighted content is distributed here.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned iOS build from commit c0bcf0814c168478d0034a60d255b45f6651569b.

**`Cemu.ipa`** - SideStore / AltStore / LiveContainer. Unsigned; they
re-sign with your own Apple ID at install.

**`Cemu-fakesigned.ipa`** - TrollStore or jailbroken only. Ad-hoc signed
with the JIT entitlements (`dynamic-codesigning`, `allow-jit`) genuinely
embedded, which a SideStore re-sign would strip. Use this one if you want
the recompiler to be able to get executable memory.

`Cemu.app.dSYM.zip` is only needed to symbolicate a crash report.

Built from `main`.

Check the `Init Cemu <sha>` line at the top of the log before judging a
build — it names the commit that is actually in the binary, and it is the
only reliable way to tell one build from another.

See `STATUS.md` for what does and does not work.

- Note that this build does not run games properly due to OOM and black screen errors, use the latest stable build. -

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kiddreads/cemu-ios-muffin/compare/v3.12-restore-v38-engine...v3.13-faster-interpreter
